shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for profile and interactive elements.

components.name: Filter Button
components.description: Pill-shaped interaction button for category filtering.
components.css: .ds-filter-btn { padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: transparent; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-filter-btn:hover, .ds-filter-btn.active { background-color: #E0003C; color: white; border-color: #E0003C; }

components.description: Standard card for listing publications, students, or jobs.

components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #fff; border: 1px solid #eee; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.5rem; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); border-color: #ddd; }

narrative.overview: A high-contrast, typographically-driven system that balances academic rigor with modern interactive delight. The design leverages a strong hierarchy with distinct accents against a clean and premium white-space-heavy canvas.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The Vibrant Red accent is used on ≤5% of any given screen.

rules.name: The Respond-to-Touch Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation appears only as a response to user state.

dos: Do use Space Mono for all dates, tags, and small metadata.
Do maintain 1.6 line-height for all body prose.
donts: Don't use blocky Notion-style cards with heavy borders.
